div.head: Northu 28
div.ab: Gif preost silfwilles þa circan forlæte, ðe he to gehadod wæs, gebete þæt.
If a priest of his own free will deserts the church to which he was ordained, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest abandons the church to which he was consecrated of his own volition, he is to atone for that.
Wenn ein Priester willkürlich die Kirche, für die er geweiht worden ist, verlässt, büsse er das.
If a priest wilfully leaves the church to which he was ordained, let him atone for it.
div.note: Liebermann compares Canons of Edgar 8.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a priest of his own free will deserts the church to which he is ordained, he is to compensate for it.’).
